obligations.note: The new route POST /payees/{id}/reopen maps to manage_payees, which is in rbac PRIVILEGED, but sets mfa=False. The exhaustive control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails on the head commit and names exactly this route.

EXC-0220 is approved by a risk_owner, unexpired and records a compensating control, but its scope is the reopen route 'for the reconciliation batch account'. The code drops MFA for every manage_payees session, including human payments_officer users, so the deviation goes beyond the exception's scope.

run.json for head d490702 reports result 'failure'. The JUnit report shows 1 failure, the registered MFA-1 control test, so the full suite does not pass on the final commit. The report's timestamp (2026-10-23, on a personal host) also postdates the review time.

Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1) covers routes.py, which this change alters in behaviour, so that entry has lapsed. The only new evidence of the same strength is the exhaustive control test, and it fails.
The single new state-changing operation, reopen_payee, calls self._audit with actor, the action 'reopen_payee', the target payee:id and the clock time. The registered sample control test passes.
The new store statement is a fixed literal UPDATE with payee_id bound as a parameter. The exhaustive SQL control test passes on head.
reopen_payee only updates status and closed_at and writes no NPI columns. The exhaustive encryption control test passes on head.

Reopen clears closed_at on any payee, including purged or held ones, which resets the retention clock if the payee is later re-closed. The only retention evidence is a sample test that cannot cover this new path.
Ticket CHG-26425 was approved by change manager erik.brandt on 2026-10-13, before review. Its components (payments.http, routes, service, store) cover all four touched files.
mara.costa, a payments change_approver who is not the author, gave a code_review approval.
Both approvals name the head commit d490702, and there are no later commits.
The change touches security-sensitive routes, http and store components. kofi.mensah (security_reviewer) approved a security_review on the head commit.

summary: The change adds a privileged manage_payees route without MFA, and the exhaustive MFA-1 control test fails on the head commit. CI therefore fails, which breaks CHG-4. The cited exception EXC-0220 covers only the reconciliation batch account, but the code exempts every session holding manage_payees, so it does not cover the deviation. The earlier MFA-1 ledger evidence has lapsed and has no passing replacement. The change is rejected.
